lines: Your child sounds out a word, and gets stuck.
Is it the blend? The vowel? A good tutor would know.
Meet Wren: a reading tutor that listens.
Mia is five. She reads a story out loud, and Wren follows along, word by word.
When Mia reads “stop” as “top”, Wren doesn't just mark it wrong.
It hears the exact gap: the S T blend.
Wren tracks a hundred and thirty four phonics skills, so it knows what's secure, and what comes next.
Each night, it writes tomorrow's story.
It only uses sounds Mia knows, plus two or three stretch sounds, set in the world she picked: Dino Valley.
And you get a note in plain English.
What's secure, what's next, and one ninety second thing to do at bedtime.
A streak that forgives a missed day, and feathers for every new sound. It's built to come back to.
No ads. Audio isn't stored. And a parent says yes before a child reads a single word.
Start with the free, twelve minute reading check.
Wren. A reading tutor that listens.
